build.compiler_identified_by_behaviour_not_sta: The sealed driver registers TEN -Ztrust-sat-perturb classes (enum-reshape enum-case-value enum-ctor enum-disc-index switch-map enum-payload marker-order marker-drop agg-field-order marker-arm) and emits under body_lineage.v2; build/<host>/stage1/bin/trustc registers six and knows none of the four marker-* / agg-field-order classes. `trustc -vV`'s date stamp is NOT a source identity (CFG_VER_HASH is pinned at build time), so the driver was identified by what it does, and SEALED before measuring because another lane replaces the shared live driver without warning.
build.log_level_is_load_bearing: A SUCCESSFUL flip logs at INFO and is therefore INVISIBLE in a default build - only the WARN `FALLBACK to built MIR` lines survive the default filter. Any re-measurement that omits RUSTC_LOG=...trust_ir_flip=info has measured nothing.

disagreements_with_the_committed_census: bodies 13770 here vs 13769 in the committed census (clean-kernel gained one body between 2821390fb and c4e33541d); lowered 9066 vs 9065; spliced 7570 vs 7569; lineage rows 13142 vs 13141. Every other whole-crate field is identical.

instr_count for expr::bvar_in_range is 13 in the coverage row (the census reports 13 too); an independently written text-dump parser counts 11 instruction LINES for the same body, because the coverage counter and a line counter are different denominators. Neither is wrong; they are not the same quantity and must not be quoted interchangeably.
candidate_selection.why_this_body: Of the 177 fully-chainable codegen-flipped bodies, exactly TWO contain a condbr (expr::bvar_in_range and env::native_reducers_char::is_valid_char) and they are the only two carrying a short-circuit as real control flow. bvar_in_range has the most comparisons of any chainable body (four icmps: eq, uge, uge, ult), seven blocks, two join blocks one of which branches into the other, three parameters, and the longest non-vacuous marker sequence (21 lines) of any chained body. It is also the only chained body whose producer-side INTERPRETER differential ran at all: agreed on 125 sampled inputs, where all four other chains are not-run.
